capabilities: Create rule groups matching frontmatter property values with AND/OR logic
Show badge icons before file names in the file explorer
Use built-in brand icons or upload custom images
Import and export rule groups and icons as a JSON file
disambiguation: Not a property or frontmatter editor; it only displays icons in the file explorer based on property rules.
extras: The built-in platform icons are simplified, brand-colored glyphs, not official logos; exact logos require the custom icon upload. JSON import/export works on desktop only.
intentEvidence: Property Icons is an independent implementation with its own rule-group engine and icon system
problem: Obsidian's file list shows only note names, so property-based state like publish status or priority requires opening each note to see.

relations.evidence: This plugin was inspired by Mark as Read / Explorer Property Attributes by Maksim Volkov (@hemy301)
relations.plugin: Mark as Read / Explorer Property Attributes by Maksim Volkov (@hemy301)

summary: File-explorer badge plugin that shows icon badges before file names based on frontmatter property rules.
